mapper.sql:
select u.user_id, u.org_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, (SELECT real_name from auth_info where user_id = u.user_id order by auth_time desc limit 1)as real_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.auth_status, u.user_type, u.brief_intr, u.avatar_name, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.wx_code, u.user_sources, u.school, u.school_name,
u.sys_user_id, u.open_id, o.org_id, o.parent_id, o.ancestors, o.org_name, o.order_num, o.responsible_per, o.status as org_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_org o on u.org_id = o.org_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.org_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name,(SELECT real_name from auth_info where user_id = u.user_id order by auth_time desc limit 1)as real_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_org o on u.org_id = o.org_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
AND (SELECT real_name from auth_info where user_id = u.user_id order by auth_time desc limit 1) like concat('%',#{realName},'%')
${params.dataScope}
where u.user_name = #{userName} and u.del_flag = '0'
select u.* from sys_user u where u.nick_name = #{nickName} and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.user_id asc limit 1

where u.del_flag = '0'
and ( u.user_name = #{userName} or (u.phonenumber is not null and u.phonenumber != '' and u.phonenumber = #{userName}) or (u.email is not null and u.email != '' and u.email = #{userName}) )
and 1 = 0
order by case when u.user_name = #{userName} then 0 when u.phonenumber = #{userName} then 1 when u.email = #{userName} then 2 else 3 end, u.user_id desc limit 1
where u.phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.user_id asc limit 1
where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0'
where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '1' and password is null

select u.user_id, u.org_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status,u.user_sources, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.auth_status, u.user_type, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, (select DISTINCT real_name from auth_info where user_id = u.user_id and auth_status ='5') real_name from sys_user u left join identity_info i on i.user_id = COALESCE(u.sys_user_id,u.user_id) where i.certification_type = #{certificationType} and u.del_flag = '0' and i.check_status = '6'
AND (u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') or u.user_id in (select DISTINCT user_id from auth_info where real_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and auth_status ='5'))
select user_id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, user_name,user_sources from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and phonenumber = #{phonenumber} limit 1
select user_id, user_name,user_sources from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and email = #{email} limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber,user_sources from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email,user_sources from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select u.user_id,u.user_name,COALESCE(ai.real_name, u.nick_name) AS nick_name, u.school, u.avatar,u.sys_user_id,nci.school_name, nci.province, nci.province_code,ii.institute,ii.position from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role sur on u.user_id = sur.user_id left join auth_info ai on u.user_id = ai.user_id left join identity_info ii on ii.user_id = CASE WHEN u.sys_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN u.sys_user_id ELSE u.user_id END and ii.check_status = '6' and ii.certification_type = 'teacher' left join nationwide_college_info nci on ii.school = nci.id where u.del_flag = '0' and sur.role_id in (select role_id from sys_role where role_key = 'special')
and u.user_id = #{userId}
and (u.user_id in (select DISTINCT user_id from auth_info where real_name like concat('%', #{keyWords}, '%') and auth_status ='5') or u.user_id in (select DISTINCT user_id from identity_info where institute like concat('%', #{keyWords}, '%') and check_status ='6'))
and not exists (select 1 from review_task_specialist_relation where user_id = u.user_id and del_flag = '0')
and exists (select 1 from review_task_specialist_relation where user_id = u.user_id and del_flag = '0')
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( open_id, user_id, org_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, status, pwd_update_date, auth_status, user_type, create_by, remark, wx_code, school, school_name, institute, user_sources, create_time )values( #{openId}, #{userId}, #{orgId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{status}, #{pwdUpdateDate}, #{authStatus}, #{userType}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{wxCode}, #{school}, #{schoolName}, #{institute}, #{userSources}, sysdate() )

insert into sys_user (user_id, org_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, status, pwd_update_date, auth_status, user_type, school,school_name,create_by, create_time,user_sources) values
(#{item.userId}, #{item.orgId}, #{item.userName}, #{item.nickName}, #{item.email}, #{item.avatar}, #{item.phonenumber}, #{item.sex}, #{item.password}, #{item.status}, #{item.pwdUpdateDate}, #{item.authStatus}, #{item.userType}, #{item.school},#{item.schoolName},#{item.createBy}, sysdate(),#{item.userSources})
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set pwd_update_date = sysdate(), password = #{password}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete:
update sys_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id in
#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT SUR.ROLE_ID AS roleId, SU.ORG_ID AS orgId, SU.USER_ID AS userId, SU.NICK_NAME AS nickName, SU.USER_NAME AS userName FROM SYS_USER SU INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE SUR ON SUR.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID WHERE SU.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND SU.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND SUR.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}

SELECT DISTINCT su.user_id as userId,su.user_name as userName,su.nick_name as nickName FROM sys_user su INNER JOIN sys_user_role sur ON su.user_id = sur.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON sur.role_id = srm.role_id AND srm.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN sys_menu sm ON srm.menu_id = sm.menu_id
AND sm.perms = #{submit}
AND sm.perms in (SELECT concat(dict_value,':task:submit') from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'audit_flow_type')
UNION ALL SELECT user_id,user_name,nick_name FROM sys_user where user_id =1

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(SU.NICK_NAME SEPARATOR '、') AS nick_names FROM SYS_USER SU INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE SUR ON SUR.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE SR ON SR.ROLE_ID = SUR.ROLE_ID WHERE SU.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND SU.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND SR.ROLE_KEY = #{roleKey}

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(su.nick_name SEPARATOR '、') AS nick_names FROM `sys_user` su INNER JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.user_id = su.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.role_id = sur.role_id WHERE sr.role_key = #{roleKey} AND sr.del_flag = '0' AND su.`status` = '0'
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(su.nick_name SEPARATOR '、') AS nick_names FROM `sys_user` su WHERE su.org_id = #{orgId} AND su.del_flag = '0' AND su.status = '0'

SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.user_name AS userName, su.nick_name AS nickName, ii.institute AS institute, (SELECT DISTINCT real_name FROM auth_info WHERE user_id = ii.user_id AND auth_status = '5' AND del_flag = '0') AS realName FROM identity_info ii INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = ii.user_id AND su.del_flag = '0' where ii.school = #{schoolId} and ii.certification_type = 'teacher' and ii.del_flag = '0' and ii.check_status = '6'

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(su.sys_user_id,su.user_id) AS userId,su.user_name AS userName,su.nick_name AS nickName,su.phonenumber AS phoneNumber,su.email AS email, nci.school_name AS schoolName,i.position, (SELECT real_name from auth_info where user_id = su.user_id and del_flag='0' and auth_status='5' order by auth_time desc limit 1)AS realName FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN auth_info ai ON ai.user_id = su.user_id AND ai.del_flag = '0' AND ai.auth_status = '5' LEFT JOIN nationwide_college_info nci ON nci.id = su.school LEFT JOIN identity_info i ON i.user_id=COALESCE(su.sys_user_id,su.user_id) AND i.del_flag='0' AND i.check_status = '6' WHERE su.sys_user_id is NULL AND su.`status` = '0' AND su.del_flag = '0'
AND su.user_type = #{userType}
AND su.user_id IN
#{userId}
AND sr.role_key = #{roleKey}
AND su.phonenumber LIKE concat('%', #{phoneNumber}, '%')
AND su.email LIKE concat('%', #{email}, '%')
AND ai.id_card LIKE concat('%', #{idCard}, '%')
AND sr.role_name LIKE concat('%', #{roleName}, '%')
AND nci.school_name LIKE concat('%', #{schoolName}, '%')
AND (su.nick_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%') or (SELECT real_name from auth_info where user_id = su.user_id order by auth_time desc limit 1) like concat('%',#{userName},'%') or su.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%'))

SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.user_name AS userName, su.nick_name AS nickName, ai.real_name AS realName, CASE su.user_type WHEN '0' THEN '管理端' WHEN '2' THEN 'C端' ELSE su.user_type END AS userType, su.email, su.phonenumber AS phoneNumber, CASE su.sex WHEN '1' THEN '女' WHEN '0' THEN '男' ELSE '未知' END AS sex, CASE su.status WHEN '0' THEN '正常' WHEN '1' THEN '停用' ELSE su.status END AS status, CASE su.auth_status WHEN '5' THEN '认证通过' WHEN '1' THEN '未实名认证' WHEN '6' THEN '认证失败' ELSE su.auth_status END AS authStatus, su.school, su.school_name AS schoolName, CASE su.user_sources WHEN 'admin' THEN '管理端创建' WHEN 'pc' THEN '用户端注册' WHEN 'import' THEN '系统导入' ELSE su.user_sources END AS userSources FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN auth_info ai ON ai.auth_id = ( SELECT ai2.auth_id FROM auth_info ai2 WHERE ai2.user_id = su.user_id AND ai2.del_flag = '0' AND ai2.auth_status = '5' ORDER BY ai2.auth_time DESC, ai2.auth_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE su.user_id IN
#{userId}
